services.name: Soshinkan Karate
services.desc: The focus of Soshinkan Karate Jissenjuku practice is the development of a strong body, spirit of harmony, peaceful heart, and usable martial arts techniques through traditional Kata containing 600 years of Okinawa history. The ultimate goal is control of an opponent through body breathing, proper posture, harmonization, and neutralization gained from kata and kata-based applications of paired training engagements. Through Soshinkan practice, one can step beyond the relative and immerse oneself in the absolute.
